transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Um... well, I'm just here because I keep hearing things. Clear voices. Mostly when I'm alone in my apartment, or... sometimes if I'm in an empty room at the museum. It just sounds like women whispering from behind the walls. They keep telling me which photographs belong in the archive. That's all.
Have you had any periods of feeling unusually energized or euphoric?

Um... I don't know about euphoric. But... I suppose there are days when I feel... radiant. Like I've been chosen. It's just... if someone questions my plans on those days, or tells me to slow down... I get furious. It feels like they're trying to erase me. That's... that's really all I want to say about that.
Have you had a period of several days or more when you felt abnormally high, energized, or irritable compared with your usual self?

I... I thought I just answered that. About feeling chosen, and getting furious. I don't really keep a calendar of it. It's just... some days are like that. I don't really pay attention to exactly how many days in a row it lasts. I'm not sure.
Have you ever had a time when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?

Well... yes, I suppose. Sometimes I only need to sleep for two or three hours. I'll wake up before dawn, and... I just feel completely ready. I don't feel tired at all. I just tell myself that sleep is... well, it's for people who don't have an archive to rescue. So I just get up. That's all.
Have there been times when your voice or activity level became noticeably more elevated or energized for several days in a row?

I guess... yes. There are nights when I just... I don't sit still at all. I'll move from labeling photographs to... rewriting the donor letters. And then reorganizing the boxes of programs. It's just... my body feels like it has a motor running through it. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Have you ever had the voices or other unusual beliefs even when you were not having one of those energized or irritable periods?

Yes... I suppose so. There was a period of a few weeks where I wasn't... I wasn't feeling energized or anything like that. But I still heard the whispers in my apartment. And... I still knew the arts people were monitoring my phone. So, yes.
Have there ever been at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or having the belief that people were monitoring you, but you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yes... like I just said. It was for several weeks. I wasn't... having those energetic days, and I wasn't feeling low, either. I was just... regular, I suppose. But the whispers in the apartment didn't stop. And I still knew the arts people were on my phone. I don't... I don't really know what else to tell you about that.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt very depressed or lost interest in things?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really had a time where I felt... depressed like that. No.
Have there been at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or believing people were monitoring you, but you were not having any manic symptoms at the same time?

I... yes, I think we just covered that. There were several weeks... I wasn't energized, I wasn't... grand or whatever you want to call it. But the whispers were still there. And I still knew about the arts people on my phone. I don't know why you're asking me again.
Has there been a continuous period of at least six months when you were hearing the voices or believing people were monitoring you?
Yes... it's been a while. About eight months, I suppose. The voices... and knowing they're watching my archive. It hasn't stopped.
Have there ever been any times when the voices or belief that people were monitoring you happened only while you were also having manic symptoms?

Yes. When I was... when I didn't need to sleep much, just working on the archive all day and night... the women were whispering then, too. And I knew the museum board was watching me do it. It all happened at the same time.
